policies.title: Studio policies
policies.intro: Clear rules so your appointment, and everyone else's, stays protected.
policies.depositBody: Every booking is confirmed with a 30% deposit of the service price. The deposit reserves your slot exclusively and is deducted from the final price. It is paid by bank transfer (alias or CVU) and confirmed via WhatsApp.
policies.cancellationBody: You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 24 hours before your appointment. With less than 24 hours notice, the deposit is neither refunded nor rescheduled.
policies.noShowBody: If you do not attend your appointment without notice, the deposit is forfeited. Let us know in advance via WhatsApp and we will reschedule.
policies.punctualityBody: Please arrive 5 minutes before your appointment. Delays shorten the session so the next client is not kept waiting.
policies.externalWorkBody: If you are coming with work from another studio, let us know before booking — removal and rework carry an extra cost the owner assesses before confirming.
policies.more: …and any the owner adds — editable from her panel.

pagoResult.errorBody: The payment didn't go through. You can try again from your booking or arrange the deposit by bank transfer. If the charge shows up in your account, message us on WhatsApp before retrying.
